structured_output.what_is_happening: "Effective FOMO" (fomo/acc), a pump.fun coin that graduated to PumpSwap the moment it was created (created_unix equals migrated_unix, so the bonding curve was filled right away, probably by a bundled launch). At 11.5 minutes old it had traded $732k on an $87k market cap (27x turnover in the first hour). About 986 unique buyers vs 734 sellers. Price is up 70% since launch and 26% in the last 5 minutes, and still about 27% below its all-time high of ~$119k market cap. It has a website, a Telegram and an X account. No paid DexScreener promotion.

narrative.description: A play on the e/acc ('effective accelerationism') meme, rebranded as 'fomo/acc'. It is a generic crypto-culture joke, not tied to any news event the packet can show.
narrative.why_spreading: Mainly early trading momentum right after migration. The e/acc tag gets some recognition on crypto Twitter, and copycat tokens with the same name suggest people are aware of it, but there is no sign of an outside trigger.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the pump.fun original with by far the most volume and liquidity. It was created a few seconds before the pump copy 4eBY..., and its linked X/Telegram accounts match the name.
token_connection.competing_tokens: There are four same-name/ticker tokens: two BAGS 'e/fomo' and 'FOMO/ACC' tokens with zero liquidity, and two tiny pump.fun copies. Two 'Effective Fomo' tokens were created about 2.5 hours earlier, so the idea itself isn't original, but those are dead.

authenticity.evidence: Instant migration together with 213 bundler wallets and 329 fresh wallets (28% of holders) points to a coordinated launch. On the other hand, the dev holds only 0.4%, the top 10 hold just 13.75%, there is no insider network, the bot/degen rate is low (3%), there are about 986 unique buyers, 4 smart-money wallets and 1 KOL (renowned) wallet, and no paid boosts.
authenticity.uncertainty: The bundler wallets may already have spread their supply across many wallets, which would make the holder spread look better than it is. Part of the volume could be recycled by bots given the 27x turnover.

structural_risks: Bundled instant-migration launch; the bundlers (top bundler traders hold 13.6%) could dump together
Liquidity is about $26.7k against a market cap of about $87k; thin enough that a coordinated sell hits the price hard
Volume blowing off very early could mark the local top soon after entry
GeckoTerminal holder distribution looks contradictory: its top-10 figure of 91% likely counts the pool account

structured_output.counterargument: Coins that migrate instantly off a bundled launch usually peak within the first 15 to 30 minutes, once the bundlers and snipers sell into late buyers. The buy at T+4 minutes comes after a 26% jump in 5 minutes, so a drop of 50% or more is at least as likely as doubling. The e/acc riff is stale and there is no event behind it.
unknowns: Whether the bundler wallets are still holding or have already sold
How active the X/Telegram accounts actually are
Whether the 5-minute buying spike is organic or bot-driven
Price action in the 4 minutes before entry

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition; the judgment rests only on the packet.

structured_output.thesis: Demand is strong and broad for an 11-minute-old coin: about 1k unique buyers, 27x turnover, price still rising, a clean structure (authorities renounced, LP burned, top 10 at 13.75%), a first-time dev funded from KuCoin, and some smart-money/KOL wallets present. The bundled instant-migration launch and heavy fresh-wallet share cap the upside and raise the risk of a sharp dump. This coin ranks above the typical coin in the pool, but a round trip is still the most likely outcome.
